race.description: Team Aidan Markets @ Crjc 22 November Hcp (Bm58)
race.comment: LORD PROTECTOR (9) claim helps and he looks to get the right run today. Chipped away late with the 57kg when fifth over 2000m at Dalby. Finds a tougher race but a big run is on the cards. WOODLAND WONDER (12) raced in town last time and offered little when eighth over 2200m at Eagle Farm in BM70 grade. Both wins are at this track and gets every chance from the good gate. PURPLE KITTY (7) scored over 1600m at Taree two back then found a couple better last time out over 2100m at Tuncurry. In the mix. MAHUIKA MAROI (5) was narrowly beaten last time when well in commission over 2200m at this track, finishing just half a length from the winner in second. Place hope again.
